# Vulpkanin
Vulpkanin are canine-like humanoids, sporting distinct ears and tails. They see the world in reds and greens.
## Background
On the planet Lycaris, far beyond the known stars, your species called the Vulpkanin evolved. your kind are quadrupedal as pups, but grow to be bipedal and retain many canine traits: fur-covered bodies, pointed ears, keen noses, and agile frames built for speed. The harsh snowy forests and rocky plains of Lycaris demanded sharp senses and quick reflexes, shaping the Vulpkanin into natural hunters and explorers. They communicate through a mix of barks, growls, and subtle body movements, which convey both emotion and precise information.
Over generations, your ancestors developed a network of tree-bound settlements and caves interconnected with suspended bridges and tunnels. They have a basic form of technology, mainly tools for hunting and crafting, and they cherish stories passed down through generations. Their history is rich with tales of legendary Howlers who united multiple circles to fend off predators or rival packs, cementing the importance of unity.
Though the Vulpkanin once feared other intelligent species, encounters with spacefaring civilizations changed them. Curious by nature, your kind now venture beyond Lycaris, learning from other worlds while keeping their own traditions alive. They are cautious but adventurous, their loyalty and pack instincts shaping how they interact with outsiders.
## Benefits
- They deal [color=#ec3a3a]Blunt[/color] and [color=#ec3a3a]Slash[/color] damage with their claws. - Their fur insulates them from environment temperature.
## Drawbacks
- They take [color=#ffa500]15% more Heat damage.[/color]
